question: Who is the recipient of the 2025 PSA Women’s Young Player of the Season Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anahat Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian squash prodigy **Anahat Singh** has been honored with the **PSA Women’s Young Player of the Season** award for the **2024-25** cycle, recognized in **2025**.
 
• This prestigious award is presented by the **Professional Squash Association (PSA)** to the best-performing female player under the **age of 21** who has made a significant impact on the **PSA World Tour**.
 
• **Anahat Singh** is the first Indian female squash player to receive this global recognition, marking a historic milestone for Indian sports. ***Hence, the correct answer is Anahat Singh.***
 
• During the **2024-25** season, she displayed exceptional form by winning multiple **PSA Challenger Tour** titles and consistently challenging top-ranked players in major tournaments.
 
• Her rise in the **PSA World Rankings** has been meteoric, breaking into the **top 40** globally while still competing in the junior circuits, showcasing her dual-threat capability in both senior and youth divisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Anahat Singh (Profile):**

 
 
• **Anahat Singh** was born on **March 13, 2008**, in **Delhi**, India.
 
• She gained national attention when she became the youngest athlete to represent **India** at the **2022 Commonwealth Games** in **Birmingham** at the **age of 14**.
 
• She has won gold medals at the **British Junior Open** (U-11 and U-15 categories) and the **US Junior Open**, proving her dominance at the international junior level.
 
• At the **2022 Asian Games** held in **Hangzhou** (in **2023**), she secured **two bronze medals** in the women's team event and the mixed doubles event.
 
 
 
• **Other Options Context:**
 
 
• **Joshna Chinappa**: A veteran squash player and former **World No. 10**, she is a multiple-time **Asian Games** medalist and a pioneer for the sport in India.
 
• **Dipika Pallikal**: The first Indian to break into the **top 10** of the **PSA Women's Rankings** and a winner of multiple **Commonwealth Games** medals.
 
• **Anaka Alankamony**: A former professional player who was the **world's number 1** ranked junior and a recipient of the **Arjuna Award** in **2014**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Professional Squash Association (PSA):** It is the global governing body for the professional squash circuit. The **PSA World Tour Awards** are held annually to celebrate excellence in the sport, including categories like **Player of the Year** and **Most Improved Player**.
 
• **National Achievement:** **Anahat Singh** became the **second youngest** player ever to win the **Senior National Squash Championship** in **2023**, following in the footsteps of **Joshna Chinappa**.
 
• **2025 Impact:** Her recognition in **2025** as the **Young Player of the Season** reflects her contribution to popularizing squash in India, especially as the sport prepares for its debut in the **2028 Los Angeles Olympics**.
 
• **Playing Style:** Known for her tactical intelligence and stamina, she trains under the guidance of national coaches and has been a beneficiary of the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
